authored_artifact.label: WHAT THIS MAP CANNOT DO
authored_artifact.placement: #map-methodology-panel, tracked uppercase micro-label matching AXES / GRADE THRESHOLDS
authored_artifact.text: Naming the mechanism behind an objection does not refute the objection. A defense mechanism can produce a true claim; a motivated reasoner can be right. This map describes why an objection is reachable from where the interlocutor is standing — not whether it succeeds. A response that identifies the mechanism and stops there has answered nothing, and has usually insulted someone. Every objection in the taxonomy carries a substantive rebuttal for that reason. Where the mechanism is genuine philosophical engagement there is nothing to diagnose at all, and those are the objections that decide whether the case holds.
